decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service draws on the firm's long-built address and postal databases and its web service infrastructure, so it costs little to maintain and fits the planned platform and standardized data exchange model.

The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's core grid fee data expertise to a neighbouring regulated market, where it can apply its existing analytical know-how, although a smaller customer base makes it somewhat more exposed.

Peak load window determination is a regulated network operator calculation tied closely to the firm's grid fee and compliance knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and keep improving it through its own R&D.
The end-customer tariff database is a multi-model line at the heart of the firm's market data business and is strongly supported by its existing databases and customer relationships.
Custom web services apply the firm's software development and data center capabilities directly and support its move toward integrated, modular SaaS delivery.

The postal code lookup service is a low-cost component built on the firm's established geographic data, useful for data quality in customer processes, though it may later be merged with the address service.
